[size=150][b]Lionheart Fixt 0.13.0 - The Road North[/b][/size]

Between Montserrat and Montaillou there are five maps of wolves, rock titans and ogres, and
almost nothing in them talks. The Plains has a cult of heretic Inquisitors who boast about the
demons they are summoning and never summon one. The mountains are full of ogres nobody ever
explains. The Abandoned Cave is 506 parts of grey wolves.

So: the ritual finishes, and something answers it. The ogres turn out to have been charmed by
the Daeva at the end of the road, and when he dies -- or is talked into leaving -- the whole
tribe stands down mid-swing across three maps. The wizard whose cut lines explain that war gives
them up at last. The three men on the road say whose men they are before they rob you, and can be
haggled, lied to, or talked past nine different ways. Your spirit finally speaks the warning all
three spirits were recorded saying. And the empty cave has a merchant in it, six weeks stuck
behind two hired swords, who will tell you what you are walking into at Montaillou.

[b]Fixt[/b] is a cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt.

Download, unzip, run [i]Mod Manager.bat[/i]. Nearly all of it needs a character who has not yet
crossed the pass. Unplayed -- what you find goes into 0.13.1.
